subject: [PATCH 2/2] cgroup/cpuset: use mems_allowed_seq when checking a policy nodemask

reviews.author: Gregory Price
reviews.summary: Identified a potential race condition in the original patch, explaining that the loop ensures nodemask and mems_allowed stability before checking for retry.

reviews.author: Vlastimil Babka (SUSE)
reviews.summary: Agreed with Gregory's assessment of the patch, noting that the cookie-check in check_retry_cpuset() cannot catch the race condition.

2026-10-15.patch_summary: A patch to use mems_allowed_seq when checking a policy nodemask in cgroup/cpuset, aimed at preventing erroneous dropping of the nodemask due to races.
